provenance.notes: Badge names, official page URLs and Eagle status were checked against scouting.org pages (the All Merit Badges A–Z list, the Eagle-required list and per-badge Merit Badge Hub pages) as returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. Listings whose official page appeared in those results are marked verified; the pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so official links remain unchecked. Test Lab badges are listed separately because they are trials rather than permanent badges.

badges.name: Auctioneering
badges.lifecycleNote: Auctioneering is a Scouts BSA Test Lab badge: a trial badge with digital resources instead of a pamphlet. Each Test Lab badge has a completion deadline, after which the National Council decides whether it becomes a full merit badge. Check its current status before starting. Its listed requirements were available until December 31, 2026.

eagle.note: Test Lab badges count as electives only if made official; check current rules.
Eagle-required status reflects 2026 council communications found by web search, not a check of scouting.org.
